digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git partial clone
propositions: CI workflows must apply --filter=blob:none to all tickets-store fetch operations to reduce transfer size and latency across standalone checkout and Gerrit verify-identity paths
Named-remote fetch must inherit the partial-clone filter configuration; direct-URL fetches in gerrit-verify.yaml must explicitly pass --filter=blob:none with appropriate depth semantics

Production guards must parse git count-objects pack size after materialization and reject fetches exceeding REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (102400) for standalone and REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (131072) for Gerrit workflows
Real-Git protocol tests must validate that filter capability is advertised, filter blob:none is sent by client, and known historical blobs remain missing after fetch
Worktree materialization with blobless fetch must complete under size thresholds and leave git count-objects state unchanged after verify-identity completes
A blobless multi-branch worktree must successfully reconverge local and remote changes with the ours driver, retain all expected events, and push the merged result
